diagnosis.rationale: The undiluted readings rise nearly exponentially through 8 h (0.501 at 6 h, 0.907 at 7 h, 1.625 at 8 h) and then abruptly compress into a narrow plateau around 1.8–1.9, consistent with loss of reader proportionality at high OD. Direct measurements of retained late-culture aliquots at 10-fold dilution are much higher after dilution correction: at 18 h, readings were 0.6608, 0.6428, and 0.6811 (mean 0.6616), corresponding to an undiluted-equivalent OD600 of about 6.616 versus the raw reading of 1.9121. Consistent corrected values were also obtained at 17 h (mean 6.468) and 16 h (6.692). Thus final-hour biomass is substantially higher than the undiluted reader readings indicate.
